terra.problem: This paragraph largely walks through the events again rather than teaching their significance. Paragraph 2 also continues the recap, so most of the Big Idea repeats the story already told.
The passage places Jehoiachin’s release in the thirty-seventh year of his exile; it does not say he had spent thirty-seven years in prison.
Saying the reader’s door is ‘going to swing open’ suggests that a similar release or reversal is assured. The passage does not promise that every reader’s circumstances will turn around.
